declarations.type:

      ASPProof.SearchRouteEndToEndReplayStateMachine.pipelineStageRank start + 1

  ASPProof.SearchRouteEndToEndReplayStateMachine.ReplayPath context length start finish →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteEndToEndReplayStateMachine.pipelineStageRank finish =
      ASPProof.SearchRouteEndToEndReplayStateMachine.pipelineStageRank start + length
